description: This file defines the ConsoleMessage class, representing console messages received in a browser automation context. It provides methods to access message details such as type, text, arguments, location, and associated page or worker objects, integrating with the Playwright framework.

classes.name: ConsoleMessage
classes.description: Represents a console message within the Playwright browser automation framework, encapsulating message metadata and providing accessor methods.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Returns the Worker object associated with this console message, if any.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the Page object associated with this console message, if any.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of console message (e.g., log, error, warning).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the text content of the console message.

methods.name: args
methods.description: Returns an array of JSHandle objects representing arguments of the console message.

methods.name: location
methods.description: Returns the location (e.g., line and column) where the console message originated.
